Terms of Service

Last updated 7 November 2026

These terms are between you and Jitin Kumar Sengar, who makes Ultron. By buying a plan or using Ultron you agree to them. Please read them together with the Privacy Policy.

1. What you are buying

A plan gives you an activation key that unlocks the Ultron app on one Android phone for a set time. All plans include the same features.

  • Spark: 7 days, ₹199
  • Surge: 1 month (30 days), ₹699
  • Apex: 3 months (90 days), ₹1,499

Prices are in Indian rupees. The time starts on the day you first activate the key, not the day you buy it. Plans do not renew by themselves. When a key expires, Ultron locks until you enter a new key. We may change prices for future purchases; a price you have already paid does not change.

2. Your key

  • A key works on one phone at a time. Activating it on a new phone moves it there. If it was moved in the last day, write to us and we can allow another move.
  • Keep your key private. Do not share it, post it, or resell it. If it is lost, write to us: we can revoke it and send a new one.
  • We may revoke a key that is shared, resold or used against these terms, or one that was paid for by a payment that is later reversed.

3. Refunds

If you change your mind, you can have a full refund within 7 days of buying, as long as the key has not been activated. Write to devxjitin@gmail.com with the email you used to buy.

Once a key has been activated, it cannot be refunded, because the plan has started. The exception is a fault that stops Ultron from working and that we cannot fix. In that case we will fix it, replace your key, or refund you.

A refund ends the key. We revoke it when we refund you.

4. Your Gemini API key and other costs

Ultron uses your own Google Gemini API key. You are responsible for that key, for Google’s terms, and for any limits or charges Google applies to it. Using Ultron also uses your phone’s internet connection and battery.

5. What Ultron does for you

Ultron acts on your voice commands. With the tools you connect it can open apps, tap, type, send messages, set alarms and more, in your name. It can misunderstand or make mistakes. You are responsible for what you ask it to do, so check anything important. Do not depend on Ultron for emergencies, health, safety or any situation where a mistake could cause serious harm.

6. Using Ultron properly

  • Do not use Ultron to break the law, to harass or deceive anyone, or to access someone else’s phone or accounts without their permission.
  • Do not try to bypass the activation key, copy the app’s servers, or overload them.
  • You must follow the terms of the apps and services Ultron controls on your behalf, such as WhatsApp.

7. Installing from outside the Play Store

Ultron is installed from an app file we send you, not from the Play Store. Android may warn you when you install it. Only install the app from the link we email to you. We update the app over the air, checked by checksum and Android’s signature.

8. Availability

Ultron depends on Google Gemini and other services we do not control, so we cannot promise it will always be available or error free. We may update, change or stop features, and we will try to give notice of changes that matter.

9. Our responsibility

Ultron is provided as it is. To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for indirect or consequential loss, or for loss caused by Gemini, your phone, your internet, or third-party apps. Our total liability for any claim is limited to the amount you paid for the plan the claim is about. Nothing here limits rights you have by law that cannot be limited.

10. Changes and law

We may update these terms and will change the date above. If you keep using Ultron after a change, you accept it. These terms are governed by the laws of India.
